title: Training Guidelines – SPČR 2018 Exam Tests
description: Exam questions on the SPČR Training Guidelines 2016 for divers

questions.question: The diving qualification grades Supervised Diver, SPČR Junior Diver, CMAS One-Star Diver, CMAS Two-Star Diver, CMAS Three-Star Diver, and the instructor grades CMAS One-Star Instructor, CMAS Two-Star Instructor and CMAS Three-Star Instructor may be awarded:

options.text: after successfully completing at least 80% of the practical-training tasks prescribed by these guidelines
only to a member of a CMAS organisation
diver grades to any Czech citizen; instructor grades only to the chair and/or vice-chair of an SČP or SPMS dive club
diver grades from age 18; instructor grades from age 21

questions.explanation: The qualification grades may only be awarded to a member of a CMAS organisation.

questions.question: For the Introduction to Diving, for CMAS/SPČR specialty courses and for diving training of children:

options.text: separate guidelines apply
the instructor has the right to set the scope of training based on the trainees' progress
no binding standard is set
no instructor qualification is required

questions.explanation: Introduction to Diving, specialty courses and child training are governed by separate guidelines.

questions.question: Training providers for the qualification grades listed in VS SPČR 2016 (the SPČR Training Guidelines, 2016 edition) may be:

options.text: SPČR (Czech Diving Federation), SPČR member federations, clubs registered with these member federations, SPČR instructors, and legal or natural persons authorised by the relevant member federation
only SPČR and its member federations (SČP and SPMS)
only SPČR member federations and clubs registered with them
only SPČR instructors

questions.explanation: Training providers may be SPČR, member federations, registered clubs, SPČR instructors, and persons authorised for this purpose.

questions.question: Anyone applying to take part in training must produce:

options.text: proof of education achieved
a psychological assessment
their own diving equipment
a valid medical certificate of fitness to dive

questions.explanation: An applicant for training must produce a valid medical certificate of fitness to dive.

questions.question: Training participation by an applicant under 18 is possible only with the written consent of:

options.text: the other training participants
the instructor running the training
any SPČR instructor with at least the CMAS Two-Star Instructor qualification
the applicant's legal guardian

questions.explanation: Participation by an applicant under 18 is possible only with the written consent of their legal guardian.

questions.question: During training the following must be observed:

options.text: the provisions of the SPČR Safety Guidelines concerning the organisation of diving
the provisions of the SPČR Safety Guidelines concerning diving equipment
all provisions of the SPČR Safety Guidelines
those provisions of the SPČR Safety Guidelines that explicitly concern training

questions.explanation: All provisions of the SPČR Safety Guidelines must be observed during training.

questions.question: Knowledge of candidates for diver qualification grades may be assessed:

options.text: only by means of final exams
either during training or by means of final exams, in writing and/or orally
either during training or by means of final exams, but always in writing
only during training, and always orally

questions.explanation: Knowledge may be assessed during training or by means of final exams, in writing and/or orally.

questions.question: Knowledge of candidates for diver qualification grades may be assessed:

options.text: in writing and/or orally
only in writing
only orally
only in the form of final exams in writing and/or orally

questions.explanation: Knowledge may be assessed in writing and/or orally.

questions.question: Skills of candidates for diver qualification grades must be assessed by:

options.text: the chair of the relevant dive club, with assistance from an instructor
the instructor who awards the candidate the qualification grade
an examination panel of at least three members appointed by the SPČR Training Committee (VK)
an examination panel of at least three members appointed by the board of SČP or SPMS

questions.explanation: Skills must be assessed by the instructor who awards the candidate the qualification grade.

questions.question: Skills of candidates for diver qualification grades may be assessed during training or by means of final exams, but in any case:

options.text: before an examination panel of at least three members
before a designated member of the SČP or SPMS board
all requirements for the relevant qualification grade must be met
at least a majority of the requirements for the relevant qualification grade must be met

questions.explanation: All requirements for the relevant qualification grade must be met.

questions.question: Awarding a qualification grade consists of:

options.text: a written (or electronic) confirmation, a copy of which the instructor sends within 10 working days to the board of the relevant SPČR member federation
issuing the relevant qualification (C-)card in the holder's name; on the holder's request the qualification can also be entered into their dive logbook with photo and personal details
entering the qualification grade into the dive logbook with photo and personal details; on the holder's request the qualification card can also be issued
issuing the qualification (C-)card in the holder's name and entering the qualification into their dive logbook with photo and personal details

questions.explanation: The award consists of issuing the qualification card and entering it into the dive logbook.

questions.question: Awarding a qualification grade:

options.text: consists of issuing the qualification card and entering the qualification into the dive logbook
consists of issuing the qualification card
consists of entering the qualification grade into the dive logbook
consists of an oral notification to the holder, with the option to arrange the issuing of the qualification card

questions.explanation: Awarding a qualification grade consists of issuing the qualification card and entering it into the dive logbook.

questions.question: If an instructor panel is tasked with assessing a candidate's knowledge and skills, the panel:

options.text: must have at least three members
elects its chair from among its own members
is represented towards the candidates by its chair
all answers are correct

questions.explanation: All answers are correct — the panel must have three members, the members elect a chair, and the chair represents the panel.

questions.question: Mark the incorrect statement. If an instructor panel is tasked with assessing a candidate's knowledge and skills:

options.text: it must have at least three members
the members elect the chair from among themselves
the chair is elected by the candidates in a secret ballot
the chair represents the panel towards the candidates

questions.explanation: It is incorrect that the candidates elect the chair — the chair is elected by the panel members from among themselves.

questions.question: Whenever a candidate upgrades a qualification or extends its validity, they must submit:

options.text: a recommendation from the dive club
a recommendation from the instructor who awarded their entry-level qualification
proof of the required entry-level qualification and a properly kept dive logbook
proof of the required entry-level qualification

questions.explanation: The candidate must submit proof of the required entry-level qualification and a properly kept dive logbook.

questions.question: Proof of the required entry-level qualification and a properly kept dive logbook must be submitted by the candidate:

options.text: before each dive, to the dive leader and/or dive supervisor
whenever upgrading a qualification or extending its validity
before each dive in difficult conditions (wind, waves, current)
before each dive deeper than 30 m

questions.explanation: Documents must be submitted whenever a candidate upgrades a qualification or extends its validity.

questions.question: The knowledge and skills of candidates for diver qualification grades:

options.text: may be assessed during training or by means of final exams
must in any case meet all requirements for the relevant qualification grade
must be assessed by the instructor who awards the candidate the qualification grade
all answers are correct

questions.explanation: All answers are correct.

questions.question: Mark the incorrect statement:

options.text: An applicant for training must produce a valid medical certificate of fitness to dive.
Training participation by an applicant under 21 is possible only with the written consent of their legal guardian.
If an instructor panel is tasked with assessing a candidate, it must have at least three members.
Whenever upgrading a qualification or extending its validity, the candidate must submit proof of the required entry-level qualification and a properly kept dive logbook.

questions.explanation: The statement about age 21 is incorrect — the correct age is under 18 for the legal-guardian consent requirement.

questions.question: The training provider has the right to:

options.text: verify whether the SPČR Safety and/or Training Guidelines are being or have been breached during training
temporarily upgrade the qualification of an instructor running the training, based on current need
appropriately reduce the requirements of these guidelines for the relevant qualification grade in line with the current state of the material, financial and personnel support of the training
if necessary, temporarily entrust the training to a holder of the CMAS Three-Star Diver qualification

questions.explanation: The training provider has the right to verify compliance with the SPČR Safety and/or Training Guidelines.

questions.question: Mark the incorrect statement. The training provider has the right to:

options.text: verify whether the SPČR Safety and/or Training Guidelines are being or have been breached during training
verify whether the training has the required quality
organise the order of lessons and practical sessions at its own discretion
remove from training an instructor who has misused their position in any way or undermined the training by their conduct

questions.explanation: Organising the order of lessons at the provider's own discretion is the instructor's right, not the provider's.

questions.question: The training provider:

options.text: has the right to verify that the training has the required quality
is obliged to provide material, financial and personnel resources for the safety, required quality and continuity of the training
has the right to remove from training an instructor who knowingly violated the SPČR Safety or Training Guidelines
all answers are correct

questions.explanation: All answers are correct.

questions.question: The instructor running training has the right to:

options.text: remove from the training area people whose behaviour disrupts the training or endangers participants
organise the order of lessons and practical sessions at their own discretion
organise the order of lessons and practical sessions taking into account the available material and technical means and the physical and mental abilities of the participants
all answers are correct

questions.explanation: All answers are correct.

questions.question: Among the rights of the instructor running training, organising the order of lessons and practical sessions does NOT include:

options.text: by collective decision of the training participants (trainees)
at their own discretion
taking into account the available material and technical means
taking into account the physical and mental abilities of the participants

questions.explanation: Organising the order by collective decision of the trainees is not among the instructor's rights.

questions.question: Mark the incorrect answer. The instructor running training is obliged to:

options.text: admit to training only candidates who meet the prescribed requirements
admit to training candidates who meet at least half of the prescribed requirements
at the start of training, inform the trainees of the rights and duties of the instructor and of their own rights and duties
at the start of training, inform the trainees of the content and organisation of the course

questions.explanation: The statement about half of the requirements is incorrect — candidates must meet all the requirements.

questions.question: During training, the instructor is obliged to:

options.text: properly explain and practically demonstrate every newly introduced task and warn trainees of possible dangers
not allow a trainee whose equipment is incomplete, unsuitable and/or insufficiently functional to perform the assigned tasks
refuse to confirm the completion of tasks and tests that the trainee did not pass, did not finish or did not perform at all
all answers are correct

questions.explanation: All answers are correct.

questions.question: Before each practical lesson the instructor is obliged to:

options.text: familiarise the trainees with the full text of the SPČR Safety Guidelines
obtain a written consent from the trainees with the content of the lesson
check the trainees' equipment and reduce the requirements for trainees whose equipment is incomplete, unsuitable and/or insufficiently functional
check the trainees' equipment and not allow a trainee whose equipment is incomplete, unsuitable and/or insufficiently functional to perform the assigned tasks

questions.explanation: The instructor is obliged to check equipment and not allow trainees with unsuitable equipment to perform tasks.

questions.question: The instructor is obliged to interrupt training if they find that continuing would lead to:

options.text: a breach of the SPČR Safety and/or Training Guidelines
exceeding the goal of the lesson
not reaching the goal of the lesson
none of the answers is correct

questions.explanation: The instructor is obliged to interrupt training if continuing would lead to a breach of the guidelines.

questions.question: Mark the incorrect statement. The instructor running training is obliged to:

options.text: at the start of training, inform the trainees of the content and organisation of the course
at the start of training, inform the trainees of the training provider's rights and duties
during training, organise the order of lessons and practical sessions in accordance with basic pedagogical principles
during training, properly explain and practically demonstrate every newly introduced task and warn trainees of possible dangers

questions.explanation: The instructor is not obliged to inform trainees of the training provider's rights and duties.

questions.question: The instructor is obliged to acquaint trainees with:

options.text: how to file an incident report
how to summon medical assistance in case of a medical emergency
the meeting schedule of the relevant SPČR member federation board
the meeting schedule of the SPČR Training Committee (VK)

questions.explanation: The instructor is obliged to acquaint trainees with how to summon medical assistance.

questions.question: A trainee has the right to:

options.text: organise the order of lessons and practical sessions at their own discretion
be supplied with equipment no older than two years from manufacture
ask for an additional explanation if they did not understand the instructor's explanation
ask to be exempted from practical tasks they already master

questions.explanation: A trainee has the right to ask for an additional explanation if they did not understand the instructor's explanation.

questions.question: A trainee has the right to:

options.text: decline a task that does not match their current knowledge and skills, medical condition or physical or mental fitness
decline a task that does not match their idea of what the practical lesson should contain
before each practical lesson, check the equipment of the other participants and bar from the lesson those whose equipment is incomplete, unsuitable and/or insufficiently functional
before each practical lesson, check trainees' medical certificates of fitness to dive

questions.explanation: A trainee has the right to decline a task that does not match their knowledge, skills, health or fitness.

questions.question: A trainee is entitled to:

options.text: before each practical lesson, check the instructor's equipment
request a replacement of equipment in which they have found functional defects
verify whether the training has the required quality and remove from training an instructor who does not meet this condition
tutor trainees who lag behind in mastering the required skills

questions.explanation: A trainee is entitled to request a replacement of equipment in which they have found functional defects.

questions.question: A trainee is obliged to:

options.text: provide the material and financial means for the required quality and continuity of training
organise the order of lessons and practical sessions in accordance with basic pedagogical principles
follow the instructor's explanation attentively
all answers are correct

questions.explanation: A trainee is obliged to follow the instructor's explanation attentively.

questions.question: During training, a trainee may only perform tasks:

options.text: they consider appropriate for the optimal training progress
they consider necessary for the optimal training progress
assigned by the instructor
assigned by another trainee who already masters the tasks

questions.explanation: A trainee is obliged to perform the tasks assigned by the instructor.

questions.question: A trainee is obliged to:

options.text: on the instructor's request, repeat the task brief and have their equipment and its fit checked
properly explain and practically demonstrate every newly introduced task
before each practical lesson, check the equipment of the other trainees
remove from training an instructor who has misused their position in any way

questions.explanation: A trainee is obliged to repeat the task brief on the instructor's request and have their equipment checked.

questions.question: Mark the incorrect statement. A trainee is obliged to immediately report to the instructor:

options.text: if they do not have their medical certificate of fitness to dive on them before a practical lesson
any health problems
any problems with physical or mental fitness
any finding that the training has led or could lead to a breach of the SPČR Safety Guidelines

questions.explanation: A trainee does not have to report that they do not have the medical certificate on them — that is submitted before the training.

questions.question: The terms shallow, medium and great depth refer, in this order, to:

options.text: depths up to 6 m, 6–18 m and over 18 m
depths up to 10 m, 10–20 m and over 20 m
depths up to 10 m, 10–30 m and over 30 m
depths up to 20 m, 20–40 m and over 40 m

questions.explanation: Shallow depth is up to 10 m, medium 10–30 m and great over 30 m.

questions.question: By a sheltered water area is meant:

options.text: a water area with restricted vessel traffic
a shallow water area in which trainees can be continuously supervised and where immediate intervention is possible in case of danger
a water area sheltered from wind and waves
a water area protected from freezing year-round

questions.explanation: A sheltered water area is a shallow area allowing continuous supervision and immediate intervention.

questions.question: By open water is meant:

options.text: a water area with a free surface, e.g. an indoor pool
a water area of any depth that cannot be considered sheltered
a water area that cannot be considered sheltered, has sufficient depth to practise the prescribed tasks and allows direct ascent to the surface throughout the dive
a shallow water area in which trainees can be continuously supervised and immediate intervention is possible

questions.explanation: Open water is an area with sufficient depth for training and the possibility of direct ascent to the surface.

questions.question: During training, a buddy team is formed by:

options.text: the entire trainee group (class)
the entire trainee group (class) plus the instructor
the instructor and at least two trainees
the instructor and one or two trainees

questions.explanation: During training, a buddy team is formed by the instructor and one or two trainees.

questions.question: Buddy teams may also be formed of buddy pairs (or trios) of trainees put together by the instructor:

options.text: at the trainees' request and/or wish
if the underwater horizontal visibility is at least 6 m
if they are equipped with breathing-gas cylinders of at least 3.6 m³ capacity
depending on the training stage, the actual conditions and with regard to safety

questions.explanation: Trainee buddy teams may be formed depending on the training stage, the conditions and with regard to safety.

questions.question: Before entering the water, members of a buddy team perform a buddy check focused on the correctness and adequacy of:

options.text: open cylinder valves, cylinder pressures, the inflator hoses on BCDs and dry suits
the function of the primary and alternate second stages of the regulators
the placement and securing of weights
all answers are correct

questions.explanation: All answers are correct — a buddy check covers valves, pressures, hoses, regulators and weights.

questions.question: Mark the incorrect statement:

options.text: During training, a buddy team is formed by the instructor and one or two trainees.
Depending on the training stage, the conditions and with regard to safety, buddy teams may also be formed of buddy pairs or trios of trainees put together by the instructor.
Before entering the water, members of a buddy team perform a buddy check.
The pre-dive buddy check focuses on the correctness and adequacy of the fit of buddy-team members' insulating suits.

questions.explanation: The statement about insulating-suit fit is incorrect — the buddy check focuses on valves, pressures, regulators and weights.

questions.question: For counting toward the dive count required for a diver qualification grade, an open-water scuba dive means time underwater of:

options.text: at least 15 minutes
at least 20 minutes
20–30 minutes
at least 10 min for SPČR Junior Diver and CMAS One-Star Diver, at least 20 min for CMAS Two-Star Diver and at least 30 min for CMAS Three-Star Diver

questions.explanation: A dive counted for qualification means at least 15 minutes underwater.

questions.question: On any one day, the maximum number of dives that can count toward the dive count required for a diver qualification grade is:

options.text: one dive
two dives
three dives
four dives

questions.explanation: Up to three dives can be counted on any one day.

questions.question: A holder of the Supervised Diver qualification is entitled to:

options.text: dive in open water to a maximum depth of 12 m, accompanied by a person with a dive-leader qualification
dive in open water to a maximum depth of 10 m, accompanied by a person with at least the CMAS Two-Star Diver qualification
dive in open water to a maximum depth of 10 m with a holder of at least the same qualification (Supervised Diver)
dive only in a sheltered water area

questions.explanation: A Supervised Diver may dive to 12 m accompanied by a person with a dive-leader qualification.

questions.question: The minimum age for entry into Supervised Diver training is:

options.text: 15 years
14 years
12 years
10 years

questions.explanation: The minimum age for Supervised Diver training is 12.

questions.question: An applicant for Supervised Diver training must, without basic diving equipment or any other aid, swim on the surface:
questions.explanation: An applicant for Supervised Diver must swim 50 m without aids.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT among the entry requirements for Supervised Diver training?

options.text: minimum age of 12
swimming 50 m on the surface without basic diving equipment or any other aid
holding a 30-second breath underwater
staying afloat for 5 minutes (treading water and/or floating)

questions.explanation: Holding a 30-second breath underwater is not among the entry requirements.

questions.question: Awarding the Supervised Diver qualification requires completing:

options.text: at least 2 dives with an instructor or 4 dives accompanied by a person with a dive-leader qualification, in open water at shallow depths
at least 2 dives with an instructor in open water at shallow depths
at least 4 dives with an instructor in open water at shallow depths
at least 5 dives in a sheltered water area

questions.explanation: Supervised Diver requires at least 2 dives with an instructor in open water at shallow depths.

questions.question: A holder of the SPČR Junior Diver qualification is entitled to:

options.text: dive in open water with holders of CMAS One-Star and/or Two-Star Diver to a maximum depth of 20 m
after completing 10 open-water dives in total and reaching age 14, apply for crossover training and assessment to the CMAS One-Star Diver qualification
take part in dives with holders of the same qualification
take part in selected specialty courses

questions.explanation: A Junior Diver may, after 10 dives and reaching age 14, apply for crossover training to CMAS One-Star Diver.

questions.question: The minimum age for entry into SPČR Junior Diver training is:

options.text: 15 years
14 years
13 years
12 years

questions.explanation: The minimum age for SPČR Junior Diver training is 12.

questions.question: An applicant for SPČR Junior Diver training must, without basic diving equipment or any other aid, swim on the surface:
questions.explanation: An applicant for SPČR Junior Diver must swim 200 m without aids.

questions.question: Awarding the SPČR Junior Diver qualification requires completing:

options.text: at least 2 dives with an instructor in open water at shallow depths
at least 3 dives with an instructor in open water at shallow depths
at least 5 dives with an instructor in open water at shallow depths
at least 10 dives in a sheltered water area

questions.explanation: SPČR Junior Diver requires at least 5 dives with an instructor in open water at shallow depths.

questions.question: Training for the SPČR Junior Diver qualification is led, the assessment performed and the qualification awarded by:

options.text: an instructor with at least the CMAS Two-Star Instructor qualification
an instructor with at least the CMAS One-Star Instructor qualification
an instructor with at least the CMAS One-Star Instructor qualification, or a CMAS Three-Star Diver authorised by such an instructor
none of the answers is correct

questions.explanation: Training for SPČR Junior Diver is led and the qualification awarded by an instructor with at least CMAS Two-Star Instructor.

questions.question: A holder of the CMAS One-Star Diver qualification is entitled to:

options.text: dive in open water with a holder of SPČR Junior Diver at shallow depths as the legal guardian or a person designated by them
dive in open water with holders of CMAS One-Star and/or Two-Star Diver to a maximum depth of 20 m
after completing 40 open-water dives, apply for the CMAS Two-Star Diver qualification
after age 18, supervise training participants on the instructor's instructions

questions.explanation: CMAS One-Star Diver may dive with holders of One-Star and/or Two-Star Diver to a maximum of 20 m.

questions.question: Entry requirements for CMAS One-Star Diver training are:

options.text: minimum age of 14
swimming 200 m on the surface without basic diving equipment or any other aid
staying afloat for 5 minutes (treading water and/or floating)
all answers are correct

questions.explanation: All answers are correct — age 14, 200 m swim, 5 minutes afloat.

questions.question: The minimum age for entry into CMAS One-Star Diver training is:

options.text: 14 years
15 years
16 years
18 years

questions.explanation: The minimum age for CMAS One-Star Diver training is 14.

questions.question: Training for CMAS One-Star Diver is led, the assessment performed and the qualification awarded by:

options.text: an instructor with at least the CMAS Two-Star Instructor qualification authorised or designated by the relevant SPČR member federation
an instructor with at least the CMAS One-Star Instructor qualification under the supervision of an instructor with at least CMAS Two-Star Instructor
an instructor with at least the CMAS Two-Star Instructor qualification
an instructor with at least the CMAS One-Star Instructor qualification

questions.explanation: Training for CMAS One-Star Diver is led and the qualification awarded by an instructor with at least CMAS Two-Star Instructor.

questions.question: Awarding the CMAS One-Star Diver qualification requires completing:

options.text: at least 5 dives with an instructor in open water at shallow depths
at least 5 dives with an instructor in open water — the first 3 at shallow depths and at least 2 more at 15–20 m
at least 5 dives in open water at shallow depths, of which the first 3 with an instructor; the remaining at least 2 may be done with a person with a dive-leader qualification

at least 5 dives in open water, of which the first 3 at shallow depths may be done with a person with a dive-leader qualification, and the remaining at least 2 at 15–20 m must be done with an instructor

questions.explanation: For One-Star Diver, 5 dives with an instructor are required — 3 at shallow depths and 2 at 15–20 m.

questions.question: A holder of the CMAS Two-Star Diver qualification is entitled to:

options.text: accompany a holder of Supervised Diver in open water to a maximum depth of 12 m
assist with supervising training participants
dive in open water with holders of CMAS One-Star Diver to a maximum depth of 20 m
act as a dive leader

questions.explanation: CMAS Two-Star Diver may dive with holders of One-Star Diver to a maximum of 20 m.

questions.question: The minimum age for entry into CMAS Two-Star Diver training is:

options.text: 18 years
15 years
14 years
12 years

questions.explanation: The minimum age for CMAS Two-Star Diver training is 15.

questions.question: An applicant for CMAS Two-Star Diver training must hold the qualification:

options.text: Supervised Diver
SPČR Junior Diver
CMAS One-Star Diver or a diving qualification of another system designated by SPČR
Supervised Diver with 15 open-water dives or SPČR Junior Diver with 10 open-water dives

questions.explanation: Entry to Two-Star Diver training requires CMAS One-Star Diver or an equivalent qualification.

questions.question: Before being awarded CMAS Two-Star Diver, the candidate must perform:

options.text: at least 40 open-water dives in various conditions
at least 20 open-water dives in various conditions, of which at least 10 to medium depths
at least 20 dives to medium depths
at least 10 dives to great depths

questions.explanation: For Two-Star Diver, 20 open-water dives are required, of which at least 10 to medium depths.

questions.question: Training for CMAS Two-Star Diver is led, the assessment performed and the qualification awarded by:

options.text: an instructor with the CMAS Three-Star Instructor qualification
an instructor with at least the CMAS Two-Star Instructor qualification
an instructor with at least the CMAS Two-Star Instructor qualification under the supervision of a CMAS Three-Star Instructor
an instructor with at least the CMAS One-Star Instructor qualification authorised or designated by the relevant SPČR member federation

questions.explanation: Training for Two-Star Diver is led and the qualification awarded by an instructor with at least CMAS Two-Star Instructor.

questions.question: A holder of the CMAS Three-Star Diver qualification is entitled to:

options.text: accompany a holder of Supervised Diver in open water to depths greater than 20 m
assess trainees' knowledge and/or skills during training for Supervised Diver and SPČR Junior Diver
supervise training participants on the instructor's instructions
all answers are correct

questions.explanation: A CMAS Three-Star Diver may supervise training participants on the instructor's instructions.

questions.question: The minimum age for entry into CMAS Three-Star Diver training is:

options.text: 14 years
15 years
18 years
21 years

questions.explanation: The minimum age for CMAS Three-Star Diver training is 18.

questions.question: An applicant for CMAS Three-Star Diver training must:

options.text: document their experience with night, low-visibility, deep diving and underwater navigation
hold at least the CMAS One-Star Diver qualification or an equivalent qualification of another system designated by SPČR
hold at least the CMAS Two-Star Diver qualification, but if they document at least 60 open-water dives, CMAS One-Star Diver suffices as the entry qualification
hold a valid licence to operate a small vessel at sea

questions.explanation: An applicant for Three-Star Diver must document experience with night, low-visibility, deep dives and underwater navigation.

questions.question: Before being awarded CMAS Three-Star Diver, the candidate must perform:

options.text: at least 60 open-water dives, of which at least 30 in more demanding conditions
at least 50 open-water dives in various conditions, of which at least 20 to great depths
at least 50 dives to medium depths and at least 20 dives to great depths
at least 50 dives to great depths

questions.explanation: For CMAS Three-Star Diver, 60 open-water dives are required, of which at least 30 in more demanding conditions.

questions.question: For the experience required for CMAS Three-Star Diver, dives in more demanding conditions are considered to be:

options.text: dives in visibility under 2 m
dives in water below 10 °C
dives below 30 m
all answers are correct

questions.explanation: All of these — low visibility, cold water and great depth — count as more demanding conditions.

questions.question: A diving instructor may be a member of an SPČR member federation:

options.text: who holds the CMAS Three-Star Diver qualification or an equivalent qualification of another system designated by SPČR, and who has sufficient knowledge and pedagogical skills to perform instructor activity
on the recommendation of the relevant dive club
on the recommendation of the relevant diving federation
none of the answers is correct

questions.explanation: An instructor may be a Three-Star Diver with sufficient knowledge and pedagogical skills.

questions.question: A diving instructor may be a member of an SPČR member federation:

options.text: who has sufficient knowledge to perform instructor activity
who has sufficient pedagogical skills to perform instructor activity
who holds the CMAS Three-Star Diver qualification or an equivalent qualification of another system designated by SPČR
all answers are correct

questions.explanation: All answers are correct — knowledge, pedagogical skills and the Three-Star Diver qualification are all required.

questions.question: Training for CMAS instructor qualification grades is organised by:

options.text: SPČR
the relevant SPČR member federation
an SČP or SPMS dive club
a holder of the CMAS Three-Star Instructor qualification

questions.explanation: Training for CMAS instructor qualifications is organised by SPČR.

questions.question: Examinations for instructor qualification grades include verifying:

options.text: the candidate's highest level of formal education
the candidate's diving knowledge and skills
the required length of the candidate's membership in the relevant SPČR member federation
none of the answers is correct

questions.explanation: Examinations include verifying the candidate's diving knowledge and skills.

questions.question: The validity of an instructor qualification grade is conditional on fulfilling:

options.text: all duties arising from the SPČR Training Guidelines
all duties arising from the SPČR Safety Guidelines
membership duties towards the relevant SPČR member federation
all answers are correct

questions.explanation: Validity of the instructor qualification depends on fulfilling all of these duties.

questions.question: The period of validity of an instructor qualification grade is:

options.text: 1 year
3 years
5 years
6 years

questions.explanation: The period of validity of an instructor qualification grade is 5 years.

questions.question: The authority to extend the validity of an instructor qualification grade rests with:

options.text: all holders of CMAS Three-Star Instructor
holders of CMAS Three-Star Instructor authorised for this by the SPČR Training Committee (VK), and/or an examination panel of CMAS Three-Star Instructors at SPČR instructor seminars
all CMAS Three-Star Instructors and CMAS Two-Star Instructors authorised for this by the SPČR Training Committee
the boards of SPČR member federations

questions.explanation: The authority lies with authorised CMAS Three-Star Instructors and/or examination panels of Three-Star Instructors.

questions.question: Conditions for extending the validity of an instructor qualification grade for another 5 years include training:

options.text: at least 20 divers including award of the qualification (or alternatively other activity for SPČR in the field of diver training)
at least 15 divers
at least 10 divers including award of the qualification (or alternatively other activity for SPČR in the field of diver training)
at least 5 divers; at the same time, the period under review must not contain more than 2 years without at least one diver trained

questions.explanation: Extension requires training at least 10 divers including award of the qualification.

questions.question: If the applicant for extending an instructor qualification does not perform other activity for SPČR in the field of diver training, they must, in the period under review, train at least:

options.text: 5 divers
10 divers
15 divers
20 divers

questions.explanation: Without other SPČR activity, the instructor must train at least 10 divers.

questions.question: If the instructor has trained fewer than 10 divers in the period under review (and has not performed other activity for SPČR in the field of diver training):

options.text: this condition cannot be substituted in any way; the instructor's qualification therefore lapses
the condition can be substituted by completing SPČR training methodology training
the condition can be substituted by attending more than two SPČR instructor seminars during the period
the condition can be substituted by passing an SPČR exam test on diving theory at the level of the relevant instructor qualification grade

questions.explanation: The condition can be substituted by passing an SPČR exam test on diving theory.

questions.question: Among the conditions for extending the validity of an instructor qualification for another 5 years, the following is NOT included:

options.text: attending at least 2 SPČR instructor seminars
completing a practical session on oxygen administration as first aid
submerging in basic kit and bringing up a marker from 10 m
bringing a buddy up from 20–30 m using a BCD and towing them on the surface for 50 m

questions.explanation: Submerging in basic kit and retrieving a marker from 10 m is not among the extension conditions.

questions.question: An applicant who, during the period under review, has trained more than 40 divers within the CMAS/SPČR system including award of the qualification and against whom no justified or substantial complaints have been raised, can extend their instructor qualification by:

options.text: attending one SPČR instructor seminar, provided they completed all the presentations

attending one SPČR instructor seminar, provided they completed practical sessions on resuscitation and oxygen administration as first aid, and demonstrated bringing a buddy up from 20–30 m and towing them 50 m on the surface
a written request addressed to the SPČR Training Committee
none of the answers is correct

questions.explanation: An instructor with more than 40 trained divers can extend by attending one seminar including all practical sessions.

questions.question: If the instructor does not meet the conditions set for extending the validity of the instructor qualification grade:

options.text: their authorisation will be suspended; the instructor will be given the opportunity to meet these conditions at the next available date
their authorisation will be suspended for 2 years
their instructor qualification will be downgraded to the next-lower grade and, for a CMAS One-Star Instructor, to CMAS Three-Star Diver
the validity of their instructor qualification will be terminated

questions.explanation: If the conditions are not met, the authorisation is suspended with the option to meet the conditions at the next available date.

questions.question: Mark the incorrect statement:

options.text: If the instructor does not meet the conditions for extending the validity of their instructor qualification, their qualification will be terminated.
If complaints are raised about an instructor, the SPČR Training Committee invites them to discuss the matter, and if the instructor attends, gives them the opportunity to respond.
The SPČR Training Committee has the right to verify the content and quality of training by surveying participants and through direct inspections.
In the event of a justified complaint about an instructor, the SPČR Training Committee may, depending on its severity, suspend the validity of the instructor qualification.

questions.explanation: The statement about termination is incorrect — failure to meet the conditions leads to suspension, not termination.

questions.question: In the event of a justified complaint about an instructor, the SPČR Training Committee may, depending on its severity:

options.text: require the deficiencies found to be remedied by a given date
suspend the validity of the instructor qualification
propose to the relevant SPČR member federation that the instructor qualification be terminated
all answers are correct

questions.explanation: The Training Committee may take all of these steps — require remediation, suspend or propose termination.

questions.question: A CMAS One-Star Instructor is entitled to:

options.text: conduct training for SPČR Junior Diver
teach theory and assess the knowledge of trainees for Supervised Diver
lead selected specialty courses
assist with training for instructor qualification grades

questions.explanation: A CMAS One-Star Instructor is entitled to teach theory and assess the knowledge of trainees for Supervised Diver.

questions.question: Authorised by, and under the supervision of, an instructor with at least the CMAS Two-Star Instructor qualification, a CMAS One-Star Instructor is entitled to gain experience:

options.text: leading selected specialty courses
teaching theory and assessing trainees' knowledge for SPČR Junior Diver, CMAS One-Star, Two-Star and Three-Star Diver
training trainees for SPČR Junior Diver, CMAS One-Star, Two-Star and Three-Star Diver in open water
training for the CMAS One-Star Instructor qualification

questions.explanation: Under supervision of a Two-Star Instructor, a One-Star Instructor can gain experience teaching theory and assessing knowledge for all diver grades.

questions.question: An applicant for the CMAS One-Star Instructor qualification must:

options.text: be at least 18 years old

hold the CMAS Three-Star Diver qualification, or hold a dive-leader qualification from IANTD, PADI, SSI, ITD, NAUI or SDI/TDI, or hold a diving qualification from another training system designated by SPČR
show that they completed SPČR training methodology training in the past three years
all answers are correct

questions.explanation: All answers are correct — age 18, CMAS Three-Star Diver or equivalent, methodology training.

questions.question: An applicant for the CMAS One-Star Instructor qualification must show that:

options.text: they completed SPČR training methodology training in the past 3 years
they completed at least 80 dives in the past 2 years
they attended at least 2 SPČR instructor seminars in the past 5 years
they demonstrated bringing a buddy up from 20–30 m using a BCD and towing them 50 m on the surface within the past 5 years

questions.explanation: An applicant for One-Star Instructor must show completion of training methodology training in the past 3 years.

questions.question: The CMAS One-Star Instructor qualification is awarded by:

options.text: the board of the relevant SPČR member federation
an instructor with at least CMAS Two-Star Instructor authorised by the board of the relevant SPČR member federation
an examination panel of CMAS Three-Star and CMAS Two-Star Instructors appointed by the SPČR Training Committee
an examination panel of CMAS Three-Star Instructors appointed by the board of the relevant SPČR member federation

questions.explanation: The One-Star Instructor qualification is awarded by an examination panel of Three-Star and Two-Star Instructors appointed by the SPČR Training Committee.

questions.question: A CMAS Two-Star Instructor is entitled to:

options.text: conduct training for all CMAS diver qualification grades
conduct training for CMAS instructor qualification grades
run a training centre
all answers are correct

questions.explanation: A CMAS Two-Star Instructor is entitled to conduct training for all CMAS diver qualification grades.

questions.question: A CMAS Two-Star Instructor is NOT entitled to:

options.text: conduct training for Supervised Diver and SPČR Junior Diver
conduct training for all CMAS diver qualification grades
conduct training for CMAS instructor qualification grades
lead selected specialty courses

questions.explanation: A CMAS Two-Star Instructor is not entitled to conduct training for instructor qualification grades.

questions.question: An applicant for CMAS Two-Star Instructor must:

options.text: be at least 21 years old
show that they attended at least 2 SPČR instructor seminars in the past 5 years

hold CMAS One-Star Instructor or CMAS Three-Star Diver, or hold a dive-leader qualification from IANTD, PADI, SSI, ITD, NAUI or SDI/TDI, or hold a diving qualification from another training system designated by SPČR
hold at least the CMAS Two-Star Diver qualification or an equivalent qualification of another system designated by SPČR

questions.explanation: An applicant for Two-Star Instructor must hold CMAS One-Star Instructor or CMAS Three-Star Diver, or an equivalent qualification.

questions.question: An applicant for CMAS Two-Star Instructor must show:

options.text: that they attended at least 2 SPČR instructor seminars in the past 5 years
that they completed SPČR training methodology training in the past 3 years (this requirement does not apply to applicants who already hold CMAS One-Star Instructor)
that since obtaining CMAS One-Star Instructor they have trained at least 10 divers for Supervised Diver and/or SPČR Junior Diver including award of the qualification
that since obtaining CMAS One-Star Instructor they have trained at least 5 divers for CMAS One-Star Diver including award of the qualification

questions.explanation: An applicant for Two-Star Instructor must show methodology training (unless they already hold One-Star Instructor).

questions.question: The CMAS Two-Star Instructor qualification is awarded by:

options.text: the board of the relevant SPČR member federation
an instructor with at least CMAS Three-Star Instructor authorised by the board of the relevant SPČR member federation
an examination panel of CMAS Three-Star and CMAS Two-Star Instructors appointed by the SPČR Training Committee
an examination panel of CMAS Three-Star Instructors appointed by the SPČR Training Committee

questions.explanation: The Two-Star Instructor qualification is awarded by an examination panel of Three-Star Instructors appointed by the SPČR Training Committee.

questions.question: Applicants for the CMAS Three-Star Instructor qualification must be at least:

options.text: 24 years old
21 years old
19 years old
18 years old

questions.explanation: The minimum age for an applicant for Three-Star Instructor is 24.

questions.question: A CMAS Three-Star Instructor is NOT entitled to:

options.text: conduct training for CMAS diver qualification grades
conduct training for CMAS instructor qualification grades
award CMAS instructor qualification grades
lead selected specialty courses

questions.explanation: A Three-Star Instructor is not entitled to award instructor qualification grades — that is done by an examination panel.

questions.question: An applicant for CMAS Three-Star Instructor must:

options.text: be at least 21 years old

show that during their training activity within CMAS/SPČR they have trained at least 60 divers including award of the qualification; the count must include CMAS One-Star, Two-Star and Three-Star Diver grades
show that during their training activity within CMAS/SPČR they have trained at least 80 divers including award of the qualification; up to 40 of them may be specialty-course graduates
hold at least the CMAS One-Star Instructor qualification

questions.explanation: An applicant for Three-Star Instructor must train at least 60 divers including the One-Star, Two-Star and Three-Star Diver grades.

questions.question: An applicant for CMAS Three-Star Instructor must:

options.text: be at least 24 years old
hold CMAS Two-Star Instructor
submit a written work (or a work prepared otherwise) on a pre-assigned topic
all answers are correct

questions.explanation: All answers are correct — age 24, CMAS Two-Star Instructor and a written work.

questions.question: The CMAS Three-Star Instructor qualification is awarded by:

options.text: the board of the relevant SPČR member federation
an instructor with at least CMAS Three-Star Instructor authorised by the board of the relevant SPČR member federation
an examination panel of CMAS Three-Star Instructors appointed by the SPČR Training Committee
an examination panel of CMAS Three-Star and CMAS Two-Star Instructors appointed by the SPČR Training Committee

questions.explanation: The Three-Star Instructor qualification is awarded by an examination panel of Three-Star Instructors appointed by the SPČR Training Committee.
